Etymology: [小] (small, lower strokes) + 丿 (slanting stroke, top) — something small being further diminished; few or little.
[夕] (evening) × 2 — two evenings stacked; many nights accumulating gives the sense of abundance or many.
[長] A pictograph of a person with long flowing hair — the flowing hair directly evokes length; extended to mean long or elder.
[矢] (arrow, left) + 豆 (bean/small vessel, right) — an arrow measured against a small vessel; short in length.
[高] A pictograph of a tall tower or raised building — layers of roof, window, and base represent height; expensive followed from the scarcity of things at height.
[宀] (roof, top) + 女 (woman, below) — a woman settled peacefully under a roof; safety and peace extended to affordability.
[日] (sun, top) + 十 (vertical stem below) — the sun just risen above the horizon; the very start of the day, hence early or fast.
[辶] (movement, outer) + 犀 (rhinoceros, inner) — a rhinoceros moving along a path; its slow, heavy gait gives the sense of late or slow.
[弓] (bow, left) + 虫 (hard-shelled creature, right) — a bow under tension combined with a resilient creature; force and toughness.
[弓] (bow) × 2 + drooping strokes — two slack bows with drooping tassels; a bow without tension is weak.
[斤] (axe, right) + 亲 (tree being cut, left) — an axe cutting freshly felled wood; newly cut timber is the freshest material, hence new.
[口] (mouth, below) + 十 (ten, top) — ten generations passing stories down by mouth; something spoken across many generations is old.
[日] (sun, left) + [月] (moon, right) — the sun and moon together; the two great sources of natural light combined give the meaning of bright.
[日] (sun, left) + 音 (sound, right) — the sun obscured, leaving only sound to navigate by; darkness where sight fails.
[青] (blue/calm, left) + 争 (contend, right) — the blue stillness overcoming contention; conflict settling into quiet calm.
[力] (strength/effort, right) + 重 (heavy, left) — strength applied to something heavy to shift it; to move.
[女] (woman, left) + 台 (platform/foundation, right) — a woman at the starting foundation; to begin.
[糸] (thread, left) + 冬 (winter, right) — a thread reaching its winter end; the final point of something, to end.
[門] (gate, outer) + 开 (two hands lifting a bar, inner) — two hands lifting the crossbar of a gate; to open.
[門] (gate, outer) + 才 (wooden bolt/bar, inner) — a wooden bar dropped across a gate; to close or shut.
[辶] (movement/road, outer) + 关 (two hands releasing, inner) — releasing something to travel along a road; to send.
[又] (hand, bottom) + 爪 (claw/hand from above, top) + 舟 (boat, middle) — two hands passing a vessel between them; to receive.
[网] (net, top) + [直] (straight, bottom) — setting something down straight beneath a net cover; to place or set down.
[走] (run, left) + 己 (self/coil, right) — the self uncoiling and springing into motion; to rise or wake up.
[宀] (roof, top) + 爿 (bed/plank, left) + 寝 components — a person lying on a bed under a roof; to sleep.
[止] (foot/stop, top) + 少 (few small steps, bottom) — a foot taking small measured steps; to walk.
[土] (ground, bottom) + 夭 (person with arms swinging, top) — a person with arms swinging striding across the ground; to run.
[水] (water, left) + 永 (long/flowing, right) — moving through flowing water over a long distance; to swim.
[人] (person, left) + 動 (move, right) — a person in constant movement; to work or labour.
[辶] (movement, outer) + 斿 (a flag or streamer flowing freely, inner) — moving about freely like a streaming banner; to play or roam.
[彳] (step/path, left) + 寺 (temple, right) — standing on a path by a temple; temples were fixed meeting points where one would wait.
[糸] (thread, left) + 売 (sell/pass on, right) — a thread being passed on continuously; to continue or go on.
[止] A direct pictograph of a foot planted firmly on the ground — a foot that has stopped moving; to stop or halt.
[癶] (two feet stepping out, top) + 弓 (bow under tension, middle) + 又 (hand releasing, bottom) — a hand releasing a taut bow; the moment of departure or launching.
[羊] (sheep/wool, top) + 目 (eye) + 人 (person below) — a person layered with wool arriving clearly in sight; to arrive or to wear.
[帚] (broom, right) + 刀 (knife, left components) + 巾 (cloth) — a broom sweeping the way back home; to return.
[目] (eye, top) + 儿 (person/legs, bottom) — a person with an eye prominent; to see or be visible.
[耳] (ear, inner) + 門 (gate, outer) — an ear pressed to a gate listening; to hear.
[人] (people, top) + 云 (gathering/speaking, bottom) — people coming together to speak; to meet or assemble.
[冎] (bones/divide, left) + [刀] (knife, right) — a knife separating bones; to divide or part.
[口] (mouth, bottom) + 冂 (enclosure, top) — many mouths within one shared enclosure speaking the same thing; same or identical.
[刀] (knife, lower right) + 止 (foot, upper left) + 舟 (boat) — a foot moving forward with a cutting motion; to advance or be in front.
[彳] (step, left) + 幺 (small) + 夂 (trailing foot) — a foot trailing behind small steps; to follow after or be behind.
[工] (work/tool, right) + 又 (hand, left) — the left hand holding a tool to assist the right; the supporting side.
[口] (mouth, bottom) + 又 (hand, top) — a hand raised to the mouth; the right hand used to eat and speak, the dominant side.
[辶] (movement, outer) + 斤 (axe, inner) — moving only as far as an axe can be thrown; near or close.
[辶] (movement, outer) + 袁 (long robe flowing, inner) — movement trailing far like long robes; far or distant.
[广] (large open building/lean-to, top) + 厶 (private/open space, bottom) — an expansive open structure; wide or broad.
[犬] (dog, left) + 夾 (squeezed between two people, right) — a dog squeezed between two figures; narrow or cramped.
[水] (water, left) + 探 components (hand reaching into a cave, right) — a hand reaching deep into water or a cave; deep.
[水] (water, left) + 戔 (two small blades/little, right) — a small amount of water; shallow.
[糸] (thread, left) + 田 (field/grid, right) — a thread fine enough to map out a detailed grid; thin or detailed.
[大] (large/person with arms out) + a dot — a person with an added mark emphasising fullness and girth; fat or thick.
[車] (cart/wheel, left) + 巠 (warp threads/light structure, right) — a cart with a light frame; light in weight.
[人] (person, top) + 土 (earth, bottom) + 壬 (a heavy load) — a person bearing a heavy load pressing down to the earth; heavy.
[辶] (movement, outer) + 束 (bundle/tight, inner) — movement bundled and concentrated into speed; fast.
[月] (flesh/meat, bottom) + 又 (hand, top) — a hand holding a piece of meat; to possess or have.
[無] Originally a pictograph of a person dancing with ornamental sleeves — empty-handed movement; the sleeves contain nothing, giving the meaning of nothing or without.
[心] (heart, bottom) + 田 (field/brain-like grid, top) — the heart working methodically through something; to think or feel.
[老] (elder, top — simplified) + 丂 (a bent tool/deliberate action, bottom) — an elder carefully deliberating; to think or consider.
[矢] (arrow, left) + [口] (mouth, right) — words as swift and sure as an arrow; to know with certainty.
[攴] (strike/tap, right) + 孝 (filial piety/learning, left) — tapping out knowledge in the manner of a dutiful elder; to teach.
